grouping_decisions: Advanced Go and Go+ share one visual family; QuickZone small and QuickZone XL remain separate because their exterior size and zone fascia differ.
Eaton xDetect small and large metal cabinets share one family composite; xDetect Mini is explicitly outside this photo's scope.
Protec 3502/3504/3508 are one 3500 family, and 3304/3308 are one legacy 3300 family. Repeat indicators are not silently included.
Notifier E10/E15 are grouped as one family, with no N16 manual assignment.
EvacGo is labelled evacuation alert equipment, and TouchControl/6000PLUS are labelled remote units. They are not represented as automatic detector-loop panels.

qa.scope: Source identity, visual recognition, duplicate/variant grouping, archive ID integrity and provenance checked. No physical-panel emulator/menu validation is claimed.
